(1) Semantic fidelity: the accepting transition (u1, at_exit & holding_box) -> u2 exactly captures 'carry the box to the exit' (the setup condition holding_box at the exit); the regression (u1, !holding_box) -> u0 captures loss of possession. Since box_fell is mutually exclusive with holding_box and a fall necessarily makes holding_box false on that step, conditioning on the persistent predicate !holding_box rather than the box_fell event is sound and actually more robust: it also covers voluntary drops, after which re-pickup (u0 -> u1, +0.1) is the only path back to the success-eligible state, so the second clause 'whenever the box falls, pick it up again' is enforced functionally. (2) Ordered transition coverage: within each state the guards are mutually exclusive and exhaustive via trailing else; in u1, !holding_box correctly precedes at_exit & holding_box (they are disjoint), so arriving at the exit without the box regresses to u0 instead of falsely accepting, and at_exit & holding_box is reachable only in u1 (a pickup cannot occur on the terminal step, since at_exit holds only on the last step and stepping onto the exit ends the episode). (3) Irrelevant events: siren_ringing, switch_toggled, and box_fell-as-event are not used, and per-state else self-loops in u0, u1, and u2 cover them, including siren starts and toggles in every phase. (4) Reachability and FINAL_STATES: FINAL_STATES is present and nonempty (u2), declared in STATES, and accepting (absorbing via else self-loop, awarded once at task success); u0 -> u1 -> u2 is achievable, no dead ends. (5) Reward safety: progress rewards are dense but bounded - +0.1 on pickup, -0.1 on loss, +1.0 terminal; drop/pickup oscillation nets exactly zero so no farming, the terminal reward is paid once, and the maximum total (1.1) is bounded. (6) Regressions are explicit where required, with a small negative reward on loss of possession. Minor observations (non-blocking): the -0.1 regression can coincide with the final exit step when the agent arrives empty-handed, which is an acceptable failure signal; intermediate density is limited to the pickup event because no proposition expresses progress toward the exit, which is the best achievable with the given predicate set.
